_readme: Stage 3 Not applicable entries are calculators whose implemented method is a generic identity, unit conversion, empirical estimate or user-defined commercial calculation for which no single electrical standard governs the calculation method. Everything not listed here has a scope_screened entry in review_records.json. Scope-screened is NOT a completed licensed-text clause review; the UI must show it as Partial, not Done. No entry here implies Verified status or independent approval.

not_applicable.ac-ohms-law: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.agl-lamp-life-curve: Lamp life versus current is empirical and fitting-specific. The calculator interpolates manufacturer-provided life points; no universal AGL standard prescribes its exponent.
not_applicable.agl-light-intensity-distance: Allard’s law is an optical visibility relationship. This calculator is not an ICAO/DGCA RVR observation system or an approved RVR calculation; no AGL electrical standard governs the simplified illuminance-at-distance equation.
